name: alert
title: Alert
description: Standalone system-level feedback banner: form errors, system notices, API responses. info/success/warning/error variants each map to a role + aria-live (error: alert/assertive, success+warning: status/polite, info: note/no aria-live) carried on the host. alert/banner/inline layout types, optional bold title (wires aria-labelledby), and a dismissible × button that animates max-height+opacity collapse then fires onDismiss({variant,type}) and unmounts. persist remembers dismissed state in localStorage under 'hbd-alert-dismissed-<id|uid>'. Exposes an imperative dismiss(); action buttons via Alert.Action carry .hbd-alert__action. Hand-ported light-DOM, no Radix.
